role_note: role is 'peer' until this node is elected. A master is a peer that won an election and was handed an operational key — there is no separate master build, and this file does not say 'master' by default. See contracts/consensus-protocol.md.

election.elects_itself_note: A node may vote for itself. It may not install itself: that needs three distinct members' signatures on a cluster trust root.

operational_key.note: Only the elected Master's node holds this, and only in the isolated signer (services/sparknet-signer.py). Its path lives under $SPARKNET_STATE_DIR, never in this vault. See security/key-management.md.
